resources.string: On the host, open the LuminalShine Web UI at %1$s, enter the PIN there and name this device \"%2$s\". Names that contain \"xbox\" or \"webos\" make the host hold the stream start, so do not use them.
The host did not confirm the unpair request. Open the host Web UI at %1$s and unpair this device there.
The host had an unfinished pairing attempt and has cleared it. Enter the new PIN.
The host cleared the pairing attempt again. Start pairing once more; if this repeats, restart LuminalShine.
The host is still holding a previous pairing attempt. Wait up to 5 minutes or restart LuminalShine, then try again.
Another device is pairing with this host. Wait until it finishes, then try again.
The host has too many pending pairing requests. Wait a few minutes or restart LuminalShine, then try again.
The host received the pairing steps from different network addresses. Stay on one network (Wi-Fi or mobile data) and try again.
This pairing attempt was replaced by a newer one from this device. Use the PIN of the newest attempt.
